//: Reviewed, intentional differences from compat/baseline.json that must not fail `npm run check:compat`. Friction on purpose: every entry needs an id (copy it from the failure output), a reason a reviewer can check, and the version that introduces it. Prefer deprecating and keeping the old API; only genuinely compatible-in-practice changes or deliberate (major) breaks belong here. Entries that stop matching anything are reported so they get removed (they become obsolete once the baseline is regenerated at release time).

allowed.reason: SliderProps became SliderProps<V extends SliderValue = SliderValue>; `value?: V` with the default V is exactly the old `SliderValue`. Bare `SliderProps`, React.FC<SliderProps> and ComponentProps<typeof Slider> are pinned in compat/consumer.fixture.tsx.
Same generic-with-default change as SliderProps.value: `defaultValue?: V` with V = SliderValue is the old `SliderValue`.

Only the manifest's printed text differs: the new generic callback type resolves to `(value: number | [number, number]) => void` for the default V, which is the old `(value: SliderValue) => void` with the alias expanded. Pinned by the Slider lines in compat/consumer.fixture.tsx.

Carousel.images widened from CarouselImageData[] to CarouselSlideData[] ((CarouselImageData | CarouselStandInData)[]) so slides without a src are possible WITHOUT making CarouselImageData.src optional. Every 2.6 call site (a CarouselImageData[] passed in) still compiles, and CarouselImageData.src stays a required string (pinned by src/test/imageCarouselTypeCompat.test.tsx and the Carousel fixture lines). The one pattern that changes: reading an element's `.src` off ComponentProps<typeof Carousel>['images'] (rare), and the owner must confirm that trade-off when merging the fix. Stays an entry until the baseline is regenerated at the 2.7.0 release.
